sessions.summary: Initialized PTSF Patient Travel Support scoping project from the lab brief. Extracted 16-area audit, resolved 3 flagged ambiguities via adaptive interview (HIC async, geolocation-Apex assignment, private OWD med-history with Apex-managed sharing).
decisions: Practitioner auto-assignment: Apex + Geolocation + Scheduled Flow reassignment
Medical History is a separate object with Private OWD + Apex-managed sharing + Restriction Rules
open_threads: Data residency: single global org vs. per-region
Migration data quality: dedup + PDF text-extractability
next_steps: Run requirements to shape epics and gap analysis

terminology.Medical Practitioner: external clinician who assesses subsidy candidates
terminology.subsidy: travel-cost assistance PTSF grants to a patient

decision_log.rationale: 15s peak latency would block UI threads; async keeps perceived latency low

decision_log.decision: Apex + Geolocation on insert; Scheduled Flow reassigns after 3 business days
decision_log.rationale: Deterministic, testable, uses standard DISTANCE(); handles 4,000 external practitioners without forcing Omni-Channel licensing

decision_log.decision: Medical History is separate object with Private OWD; Apex-managed sharing tied to assignment lifecycle; Restriction Rules block internal profiles
decision_log.rationale: Meets 'only while open' TTL requirement and 'internal users never see' rule with auditable enforcement
